duration.$description: Duration for extra-large surface transitions with an intentional spring settle, such as navigation drawers and full-width panels. Pair with transition/D/easing. Reduced mode must resolve to zero motion.

easing.$description: Spring easing for extra-large surfaces when bounce is part of the intended behaviour. Pair with transition/D/duration. Use C for a smooth settle without bounce. Reduced mode must resolve to linear.
Page departure curve for outgoing scale and opacity. Full: cubic-bezier(.6,0,1,1). Reduced: linear. Pair with transition/C/duration.
Page arrival curve for incoming scale. Full: cubic-bezier(0,0,.4,1). Reduced: linear. Pair with transition/C/duration. Do not add an incoming page opacity fade.
